note: Which runner owns each test file under tests/. Files pytest collects need no entry. Everything else needs one, with a reason; scripts/check-test-census.py fails on any test file that is neither collected nor listed. First matching glob wins, so exclusions must precede the broad lane globs.
shards_note: How many parallel jobs each lane is split into. The workflow matrix and scripts/check-test-baseline.py both read this, so a matrix that grows or loses a shard without updating this file fails the gate instead of quietly changing what CI covers.

shell.description: Shell tests, run one process per file by scripts/run-test-shard.py --lane shell.

script.description: Files named test_*.py that are programs with a main() and no pytest test functions. pytest collects nothing from them, so they were invisible to any pytest-based gate.

excluded.description: Not run in public CI. Every entry states what it needs that a public runner cannot give: network, an installed runtime, a terminal multiplexer, a model provider, or a non-Linux host.

assignments.reason: network: harness/lib/agent_arena_benchmark.py git-clones https://github.com/nousresearch/hermes-agent.git (226 MB, unpinned) into harness/vendor/. Public CI must stay deterministic and credential-free, and the clone lands inside the working tree.

local ML runtime: needs venvs/mia-memory-serve/ with torch, transformers and openai, a downloaded sentence-transformers BERT snapshot under ~/.cache/huggingface, vendor/MIA, and a server on fixed port 5197. A public runner has none of these, and the test spends its whole timeout retrying curl against a server that never starts.

live provider: runs autosci_bridge.py research with --allow-network and the approval ref phase5-content-diversity-user-authorized-network-provider, so it performs real web retrieval and real model calls. It also hangs rather than failing when no provider answers. Public CI must stay deterministic, credential-free and non-model-backed.
non-Linux host: shells out to wsl.exe -d Ubuntu, which only exists on a Windows host, and expects a prebuilt venv under .codex-tmp/phase5-platform-rerun-final-venv.
other workflow: Pester, run by .github/workflows/install-matrix.yml on windows-latest. The nine shards are Linux, so this cannot run there. Covered, but not by this gate - see GAP-011.
NO RUNNER. Pester file that nothing executes: no workflow and no script references it. Kept because it is a Windows evidence-doctor contract, not because it runs. See GAP-013.

other workflow, conditionally: three of these nine are run by .github/workflows/desktop-build.yml, which triggers on pull requests to main under desktop/** paths only. This branch targets openJiuwen-Solar, so none of them run here. The other six are referenced by nothing. See GAP-013.

NO RUNNER. `bun test` would discover these, and package.json defines `test = bun test`, but no workflow runs it - install-matrix.yml runs `bun install` only. Seventeen TypeScript test files execute nowhere. See GAP-013.
NO RUNNER. Same as tests/core/*.test.ts: a bun target with no workflow behind it. See GAP-013.
NO RUNNER. Node test files referenced by no workflow, script or package.json entry. See GAP-013.
